Singapore addresses wage dispute for hundreds of Indian and Bangladeshi workers

Approximately 400 migrant workers from India and Bangladesh have alleged unpaid wages from firms in Singapore. Singaporean authorities are reportedly planning to provide cash aid and job placement assistance to these workers, who have been left without pay for months. The situation has led to work stoppages at construction sites, impacting the workers' livelihoods.
